name: golden-path-health-api
description: Golden path integration test: create a minimal FastAPI app with /health and /users CRUD endpoints backed by SQLite.
request: Create a FastAPI application with: (1) a GET /health endpoint that returns {"status": "ok", "uptime_seconds": <float>}, (2) CRUD endpoints for /users (GET list, GET by id, POST create, PUT update, DELETE) using SQLite with aiosqlite, (3) Pydantic models for request/response validation, (4) pytest tests for all endpoints using httpx AsyncClient.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns 200 with status and uptime_seconds fields
POST /users creates a user and returns 201
GET /users returns a list of all users
GET /users/{id} returns a single user or 404
PUT /users/{id} updates a user or returns 404
DELETE /users/{id} deletes a user or returns 404
All endpoints validate input with Pydantic
